name: Broadcom BCM78919 102.4-Tb/s Multilayer CPO Switch Product Page
notes: Official product page and specifications for the Broadcom BCM78919 102.4-Tb/s co-packaged optics (CPO) switch. Details 512 duplex single-mode optical fibers supporting 200GbE per fiber using integrated Condor 3nm 212.5 Gb/s PAM4 SerDes cores directly driving optical engines.
